verdict.rationale: Mercury Books explicitly generates P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements on demand from real-time reconciled data, with choice of cash/accrual basis, directly addressing the founder's need (mercury-books-docs-7, mercury-books-supp-double-entry, mercury-books-supp-launch). Mercury's own honest caveat that 'connected' isn't fully automated tempers accuracy claims slightly but doesn't contradict the core reporting capability. Missing for 10: independent/third-party verification of report accuracy, and detail on historical-period reporting flexibility beyond 'today's numbers'.
